items.predicate: where not is_bot
and page_views > 0
case when shipments.delivery_days > 5 then true else false end
case when items.unit_price < products.list_price then true else false end
case orders.status when 'completed' then 'complete' … else 'other' end
case when gross_margin - shipping_cost_total - discount_total > 0 then true
and sessions.session_date <= orders.order_date
count(session_id) filter (where channel <> 'direct')
where customer_id is not null
count(shipment_id) filter (where is_late_delivery)
where promotion_id in (select promotion_id … where promo_channel <> 'internal')
where snapshots.warehouse_code <> 'WH_TEST'
case when recency_days <= 30 then 3 when recency_days <= 90 then 2 else 1 end
case when order_count >= 4 then 3 when order_count >= 2 then 2 else 1 end
case when lifetime_value >= 500 then 3 when lifetime_value >= 150 then 2 else 1 end
case when rfm_score >= 330 … when rfm_recency_score = 1 … when rfm_score >= 220 …
rfm_monetary_score = 3 as is_high_value
sum(items.quantity) filter (where items.is_discounted)
where orders.order_status_group = 'complete'
sum(case when is_late_delivery then 1 else 0 end)
where shipped_at is not null
count(distinct orders.customer_id) filter (where orders.previous_order_date is not null)
